items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Well, no, this wasn't the band that Lester played. That was Art Bronson's band that Lester -- ... because between Lester and Eddie, they could get them through it

ctx.x: Art Bronson used to have a big band in Denver. He had a good guys like Lester Young and all those type of guys. In fact, this is -- you know, I'm first to kind of getting around some guys, you know?
